caption: The drawing shows a detailed illustration of a long, elegant dress with no head, hands, or feet depicted. The main dress is an off-the-shoulder gown in a light beige or cream color, covered with a repeating pattern of pink flowers with green stems and small purple accents. The bodice is fitted and features vertical seam lines and structured shaping, while the skirt is full and bell-shaped, extending to the floor. There is a diagonal seam that forms a “V” at the waistline, and horizontal seam detail near the hem. The sleeves are long and fitted with bands or pleats around the upper arms and additional floral patterning. A matching shawl or stole is draped over the shoulders, crossing at the front. In the upper right corner, there is a simple line drawing of the back view of the same dress, showing the gathered fabric and low backline, along with horizontal seam detail. The artist's name, "MAE SZILVASY," is written in the bottom right corner of the page. The background is plain and light-colored, emphasizing the dress and its floral detail.
title: Dress
